plugins.name: ios-spm
plugins.description: iOS Swift Package Manager update workflow for Xcode-managed projects. Discovers outdated direct/transitive packages, applies picks via project.pbxproj edits + xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies, optionally verifies with a build, and opens a PR with changelog summaries. Fills the gap Renovate can't natively close (renovatebot/renovate#9735).
